summary.intent: Complete Phase 23 (Rust SDK extraction) gap closure, perform a security review of the extracted Rust crates, increase test coverage to address Codecov concerns, and get PR #352 merged-ready by resolving CI failures and reviewer comments.
summary.outcome: Phase 23 fully closed with all 8 plans complete; security review identified and fixed 2 HIGH issues (Ed25519 zeroization); 163 new unit tests added across 3 crates; Windows CI fixed by gating fuser under cfg(unix); 21 PR review comments resolved across two rounds; PR #352 pushed and ready.

repo: fuser (Unix FUSE library) is vendored at apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/fuser and patched via [patch.crates-io] at workspace level — this causes it to be resolved on all platforms regardless of feature flags
ed25519-dalek requires the 'zeroize' feature flag to be explicitly enabled in workspace Cargo.toml for SigningKey to zero on drop — it is NOT automatic
The workspace uses cargo llvm-cov --workspace on Linux in CI for Rust coverage reporting to Codecov
Git commits require 1Password SSH agent for signing — agent is intermittently unresponsive and requires retries
The cipherbox-fuse crate has two platform paths: src/platform/macos.rs (and shared operations.rs) and src/platform/windows/ — both must be kept in sync for dead code removal and fixes
ipns_private_key callers in write_ops.rs were redundantly wrapping the return of generate_ed25519_keypair in Zeroizing::new() before the return type was changed
Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> does not implement TryInto<[u8; 32]> directly — must use .to_vec().try_into() or equivalent to convert to fixed-size array

code.finding: generate_ed25519_keypair was returning bare Vec<u8> for private key — changed to Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> to prevent private key material surviving in freed memory
Caller was wrapping generate_ed25519_keypair result in redundant Zeroizing::new() — simplified after return type change
ipns_private_key.try_into() on Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> fails — must use .to_vec().try_into()
Same Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>.try_into() issue on Windows path
Copy-paste bug: app_version field was being set to device_info.device_id instead of the already-moved app_version — required saving app_version before the partial move into device_entry
fetch_and_populate_folder and resolve_file_pointers_blocking were dead code — existed in both macOS/Linux and Windows platform paths, never called from outside
IpnsPublishRequest derived Debug which would leak encrypted IPNS key bytes — replaced with custom Debug impl that redacts sensitive fields
get_bytes method was dead code (never called) — removed rather than fixing the missing status code check
Temp dir cleanup was happening before unmount — reordered so cleanup runs after successful unmount, including all early return paths
fuser and unicode-normalization must be under [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] not top-level optional deps — otherwise [patch.crates-io] forces Cargo to resolve and compile them on Windows
Same fuser gating fix required in the fuse crate Cargo.toml
Vendored fuser build.rs panics on Windows with 'unimplemented!' — added early return for cfg(windows), though the real fix was the target-gated dependency

workflow: When a GSD executor agent disconnects mid-plan, check git log for commits matching the plan tasks — the code work may be complete even if bookkeeping (SUMMARY.md, STATE.md, ROADMAP.md) is missing
Parallel subagent spawning for independent crate test writing (crypto, core, SDK) works well — each agent gets fresh 200k context and returns a detailed result summary

[patch.crates-io] in workspace Cargo.toml applies to ALL workspace members on ALL platforms — platform-specific crates must use [target.'cfg(...)'.dependencies] to avoid cross-platform compilation failures
cargo llvm-cov --workspace is already wired in CI — adding tests anywhere in the workspace automatically improves Codecov coverage with no CI changes needed
CodeRabbit generates many comments per push — batching reply+resolve in a single pass is more efficient than addressing them one-by-one

friction: 1Password SSH agent intermittently refused to sign commits, requiring 3+ retry attempts per commit session
The initial executor agent disconnected with ConnectionRefused mid-execution, leaving code committed but bookkeeping incomplete — required manual recovery and spot-checking

Windows cargo check failed in two stages: first the vendored fuser build.rs panicked, then after fixing that, fuser's Unix-only Rust source still compiled due to workspace-level [patch.crates-io] — required two separate fixes
Cross-language parity CI job was failing due to missing pnpm version in setup action — obscure error unrelated to the code changes
Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> does not implement TryInto<[u8; 32]> which required extra .to_vec() calls in two separate platform paths
gh api output for job logs required multiple attempts with different flag combinations to extract actual error lines
open_items: file_ipns_private_key in write_ops.rs (line ~174) still uses ed25519_dalek directly and returns plain Vec<u8> without Zeroizing — flagged during security fix but left as out-of-scope
AES-CTR decryption lacks client-side CID integrity verification (HIGH finding from security review) — not fixed, only documented in the security review report
Security review report (.planning/security/REVIEW-2026-03-24-phase23.md) was included in PR #352 — verify this is intentional for a production repo before merge
The .release-please-manifest.json merge conflict resolution added 5 new Rust crate entries — verify release-please is configured to handle these new crates correctly in future releases
